name: Opiner Me
author: eeqsoft

sections.description:
Opiner Me – Feedback & Star Rating Plugin

Opiner Me is a lightweight WordPress plugin for collecting user feedback, opinions, and star ratings. Includes SEO-friendly JSON-LD markup and basic spam protection. Easily add opinion forms anywhere with simple shortcodes.

Links

Official website: Opiner Me WP Plugin
Installation video: Watch on YouTube

Features

  • Opinion & feedback form with star rating
  • Shortcode integration for forms and review lists
  • SpamGuard module for basic filtering
  • Logger and LogViewer for debugging
  • SEO-friendly JSON-LD structured data
  • Lightweight, fast, and theme-agnostic

Why choose Opiner Me?

  • Lightweight and fast – no unnecessary code, no bloat, no performance impact.
  • Simple to use – install, activate, add shortcode, done. No complex setup.
  • SEO-ready – built-in JSON-LD markup helps search engines understand your ratings.
  • Clean UI – minimal, theme-agnostic design that fits any WordPress site.
  • Modular architecture – extend or customize functionality with clear, structured PHP classes.
  • Spam protection included – the SpamGuard module filters basic unwanted submissions.
  • Flexible shortcodes – display the form, the list, or both together anywhere on your site.
  • Privacy-friendly – all opinions stay in your database; nothing is sent to external servers.

Use Cases

  • Collect quick feedback from visitors
  • Add star ratings to posts or pages
  • Gather user opinions without long forms
  • Display reviews anywhere using shortcodes
  • Improve SEO with structured review data

Shortcodes

[opiner_me] – display form and list together
[opiner_me_form] – display only opinion form
[opiner_me_list] – display submitted reviews
[opiner_me_rating] – display average rating
[opiner_me_schema] – display JSON-LD

Video

Quick installation video (2.5 minutes): Watch on YouTube

This short video shows how to install and use Opiner Me in under 3 minutes.

Performance

Opiner Me is optimized for speed:
* No external scripts
* No heavy assets
* Minimal database footprint

Compatibility

Tested with WordPress 6.0–6.9
Requires PHP 8.0 or higher

Privacy

Opiner Me does not collect or transmit personal data. All submitted opinions remain in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/opiner-me/ or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Place the [opiner_me] shortcode in any post or page to display the opinion form and review list.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the form?

Yes, the plugin uses clean CSS and modular PHP classes. You can override styles or extend logic via hooks.

Does it block spam?

Basic spam filtering is included via the SpamGuard module. You can extend it or integrate with external tools.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, Opiner Me is designed to be lightweight and theme-agnostic. Minor CSS tweaks may be needed for full visual harmony.

Will reviews affect SEO?

Yes, the plugin outputs structured data (schema.org), which can improve visibility in search results.

How do I display the form?

Use the [opiner_me_form] shortcode to show the opinion form and [opiner_me_list] to display submitted reviews. You can also use [opiner_me] to output both together in any post or page.
